question: Is there a discount code or a good deal on the ESR 100W 6-in-1 MagSafe charging station right now?
query: ESR 100W 6-in-1 MagSafe charging station discount code deal October 2026

rec.answer:
**Assuming you’re shopping in the US, `PARTNER18` is worth trying at ESR’s checkout**—but I can’t personally confirm it still applies.

- **Reported price:** $142.99 → **$117.26 before tax** with the 18%-off code. [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/) reports testing that combination in ESR’s cart on October 27.
- **Where to try it:** [ESR’s official 100W 6-in-1 MagSafe + CryoBoost listing](https://www.esrtech.com/products/100w-6-in-1-charging-station-with-magsafe-cryoboost).

**There was a much better Amazon deal at $64.99** on October 22–23, but [the deal report](https://9to5toys.com/2026/10/23/esr-6-in-1-100w-charging-station-powers-all-your-apple-devices-just-65/) now marks it expired.

**My take:** Try the code if you need it now; if you can wait, I’d hold out for another sale closer to $65 rather than pay $117. Check the final cart total before ordering, since prices and coupon eligibility can change.
